known_gaps: turning the customer's words into negotiation events (and dates into YYYY-MM-DD) is done by the dialogue model; offers, counters, dates, amounts, read-back, recording, notes and the close are code
callback window validity is decided by the dialogue model from code-computed window facts (not code)
identity flow (which question, re-asks, declines) follows the dialogue model with the bank's verification results

extra rule (stateful, stage opening): Confirmation needs an explicit yes-type answer; ask once more, then close not_reached/unclear; answering a customer question first, the following ask is the second ask. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage identity): Numeric-only dates of birth are read day, month, year before converting to YYYY-MM-DD. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Wrong answers are counted across both questions; three in total end the check; a day_month_swapped retry does not count. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage identity): Explain once why questions protect the account; a second refusal or second 'what is this about' closes as not_verified/declined. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): Resolve 'next <weekday>' as following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as current week before date checks. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Floor offered only once after 'too much' or below-floor amount; refusing the floor or the deadline counts as a flat refusal using a persuasion attempt. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Count persuasion attempts per band; customer-proposed dates/amounts are never refusals; stop when attempts are used and never repeat a refused offer. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Hardship takes precedence over persuasion and restructuring; no persuasion attempts after hardship unless the customer names a date or amount. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): A change at the readback step invalidates confirmation; re-check and read back again. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Ask once whether you can help before transferring to a human. - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage global): Count 'do not want to talk' statements; on the second, close no_promise/refused after verification or not_verified/declined before. - left to the dialogue model's prompt
